reviews.comment: Taking this course is not better than self-study.

This class was one of the most difficult math classes I have taken, but he gives a lot of extra credit on all exams and assignments. I had 5 missing assignments at the end of the semester, but he allowed me to turn all of them in for full credit bringing my grade up from a D to an A. His lectures were a little boring but wrote good notes.

Awful lecture. He can't even proceed the course in a proper speed, besides regular classes, he gave a couple of extra classes. The lecture notes are bad material for study, really difficult to read. Homework is very time consuming and not helpful at all. If you have to take this course, take the one given by another professor.

I very much enjoyed this course, and I found it very informative. I think that Dr. Zelenko is a strong teacher, and he posts all of the class notes with the course notes, making it accessible to students while doing the coursework. There are a lot (usually around 20-50) of bonus points available on the homework, so doing the extra work pays off.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Zelenko is a decent Calculus 3 professor. That being said his lectures are very slow and drawn out. I found it hard to succeed in a class when the professor only would work out one practice problem in class on a certain topic, and sometimes he would skip notes all together to keep up with the syllabus.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, Mr. Zelenko is a good choice. He does know what he is doing. I wouldn't skip lectures as he basically explains how to do the homework during them and the quizzes, being two questions, can seem sort of all or nothing. If you make a point to understand how the math works though, as Mr. Zelenko tries to do, you'll be able to score an A or B
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Zelenko teaches many classes at once but manages to do it all. The time it takes to get grades back on exams leaves something to be desired, took almost a month for my second exam, but he prioritizes ensuring students know where they stand in the class. He does have an accent but its not that heavy. TAKE DR. ZELENKO.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He gave so much extra credit I could have passed without taking the final. The lectures aren't amazing, but I've also seen much worse. He gives a reliable study guide with suggested problems before each exam, so there is no reason you should not succeed. Diff eq is about learning a process and repeating it. Put in the effort and you'll be fine.

His class is not easy. The test averages were pretty low . However, he curves. The homework assignments are very difficult, although they do have bonus questions. However, he is a caring professor. I joined the class at the end of add/drop week and he was very understanding while I was making my transition into his class. He does have an accent tho

reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Zelenko is a great professor. This isn't a simple course but he provides you with loads of extra credit opportunities. The workload in this course is not very heavy. Come exam time, Zelenko provides multiple practice problems/answers covering every topic on the exam. If you work and understand all the problems you will likely get an A.

I hated this guy after the first exam. I got a B on the first one, and it was all thanks to my own work and review in the 12 hours prior to the exam. His lectures were useless for me, and his homework barely taught me anything when I decided to do it (or could). Khan Academy and the book were all I needed to learn this material; no help from him.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It honestly sounds like hes talking to himself out loud when he teaches, more or less rambling. He has an accent, so its even more difficult to understand him. Get a chegg account and youll be just fine though. His homework problems are identical from the book, so you can work solutions from the book on chegg and figure it out.
Has a lot of knowledge and is very helpful. But, it is not easy to understand his accent
